BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions, answered.

Which languages and tests can I prepare for?

Tejis offers English preparation for IELTS, French preparation for TCF and TEF (including Canada variants), and German preparation for Goethe levels A1, A2, B1 and B2.

How does the 20% discount work?

The first 20 people to enrol receive 20% off their classes. IELTS and French preparation are 60,000 FCFA instead of 75,000 FCFA per training; German is 120,000 FCFA instead of 150,000 FCFA per level. Contact Tejis to confirm eligibility and availability.

What are the class times and course duration?

Contact the centre to confirm current class times, available places and training duration before enrolling.

Does a preparation course include the official exam fee?

The listed prices are for training. Ask Tejis to confirm exam registration arrangements and any separate exam fees before enrolling.

How can I enrol or visit the centre?

Call or WhatsApp +237 694 92 16 69, or visit Tejis Language Center in Nlongkak, opposite Hotel Franco in Yaoundé.
